meanings.usage: 描述物品或空间的尺寸大小
用于观看节目的电器设备，简称TV
表示位置接近于某个地点或物品
建筑物中用于通风和采光的开口
定期出版的刊物，包含文章和图片
有腿和台面的家具，用于放置物品
每日或定期出版的新闻刊物
播放音乐和音频的设备

phrases.usage: 表示存在，用于介绍某处有某物

examples.en: There is a table in the room.
There are some books on the stereo.

phrases.usage: 表示在窗户附近的位置

examples.en: The television is near the window.
The pictures are on the wall.
The stereo is near the door.

phrases.usage: 表示在桌子附近的位置

examples.en: The armchairs are near the table.

phrases.usage: 表示在电视上面的位置

examples.en: There are some magazines on the television.

phrases.usage: 表示在桌子上面的位置

examples.en: There are some newspapers on the table.

phrases.usage: /ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm/ noun. 客厅，起居室（指家庭用于接待客人和休闲的房间）

grammar.title: There be句型（存在句）
grammar.structure: There is/are + (a/an/some) + 名词 + 介词短语
grammar.definition: 用于表示某处存在某人或某物，是英语中描述位置和存在的重要句型 当名词是单数或不可数名词时用there is；当名词是复数时用there are。some用于肯定句，any用于否定句和疑问句

examples.en: There is a television in the room.
There are some armchairs in the room.

grammar.title: some和any的用法
grammar.structure: some + 可数名词复数/不可数名词；any + 可数名词复数/不可数名词
grammar.definition: some和any都表示“一些”，但用法有所不同 some用于肯定句，any用于否定句和疑问句。但在表示请求或希望得到肯定回答的疑问句中，也可用some

examples.en: There are some magazines on the television.
Are there any books on the stereo?

patterns.pattern: There is + (a/an) + 单数名词 + 介词短语

original.en: There is a television in the room.

imitations.en: There is a table in the room.
There is a stereo in the room.

patterns.pattern: There are + some + 复数名词 + 介词短语

original.en: There are some armchairs in the room.

imitations.en: There are some pictures in the room.
There are some magazines on the television.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are + 介词短语

original.en: The television is near the window.

imitations.en: The stereo is near the door.
The pictures are on the wall.
